description: File generation node that creates simulation input files from the validated plan
philosophy: Intent-driven contract with computation output in workflow_history.details only

required_inputs.workflow_history: List[Dict] (must contain architect plan and reviewer approval)

data_source_architecture.plan_data: READ by searching: next(e for e in workflow_history if e['node'] == 'architect')['details']
data_source_architecture.approval_data: READ by searching: next(e for e in workflow_history if e['node'] == 'reviewer')['details']
data_source_architecture.NOT_from_top_level: Do NOT look for selected_case, modifications at top level - they're only in workflow_history

state_updates_returned.description: Dual validation paths: canonical (workflow_history) + pragmatic (state convenience)

canonical_data_location_PRIMARY.purpose: Source of truth for file generation audit trail

pragmatic_data_location_OPTIONAL.purpose: Convenience for runner node (can read from state OR workflow_history)

note: Generation results go in workflow_history.details (source of truth), state can have convenience copies for runner

generation_result_structure.description: File generation results stored in workflow_history[-1]['details']

optional_fields.validation_errors: List[str] (any issues found in generated files)
optional_fields.file_hash: str (SHA256 of inputs file for reproducibility)

workflow_history_entry_CANONICAL.description: Canonical workflow_history entry for input_writer node

required_fields.node: Literal['input_writer'] (identifies which node created this entry)
required_fields.timestamp: str (ISO 8601 format with Z suffix, UTC)
required_fields.iteration: int (global iteration counter for workflow state)
required_fields.details: Dict containing run_directory, inputs_file_path, and generation status

test_cases.description: Inputs file generated successfully with all modifications

critical_dependencies.consequence: Input writer needs baseline.local_path to locate template files
Input writer should only run if reviewer.status == 'approved'

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: ONLY at top level, REQUIRED for downstream nodes
schema_compliance_checklist.canonical_format: Absolute filesystem paths, created before returning
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Runner cannot find files for execution

schema_compliance_checklist.requirement: Must contain generation results and applied modifications
schema_compliance_checklist.violation_consequence: Audit trail incomplete, cannot reproduce generated inputs
